The powers, duties and functions of the Commission
to advice the Government of Sri Lanka on matters
relating to UNESCO programmes and projects;
to  promote  and  disseminate  among  UNESCO
beneficiaries in Sri Lanka an understanding of the
objects,  functions  and  purposes  of  UNESCO
programmes and projects and to conduct meetings,
seminars and lectures for that purpose;
to work towards the achievement of the objects of
the  Commission  with  the  co-operation  of  the
relevant government and local autonomous bodies,
international  non  governmental  organizations,
United  Nations  agencies,  governmental  and  non
governmental  organizations,  private  and  public
sector  institutions;
to organize programmes in the fields of education,
science, culture, mass media, communication and
other  relevant  disciplines  including  programmes
